title: Tencent/BrowserSkill: let agents work in your existing browser session
friendlyTitle: BrowserSkill lets AI agents use your logged-in browser
summary: BrowserSkill combines a CLI and browser extension so shell-capable AI agents can automate a user's real, logged-in browser without taking over the active window. The repository had about 1,400 stars when checked and was one of today's strongest AI-related trending candidates.
friendlySummary: This tool connects AI agents to a browser session that is already signed in. It can work in the background through a command-line tool and browser extension.
whyItMatters: It can help coding agents test authenticated web apps or complete browser workflows that are difficult in a clean automation profile. Use a separate low-privilege browser profile where possible, because access to a live session also exposes sensitive accounts and data.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test private web apps or automate signed-in tasks. A separate browser profile with limited access is safer than giving an agent your main browser.
